reasoning: Three vertical bars of unequal height are universally read as a bar chart, statistics, or analytics. It fits tasks centered on charts, metrics, data analysis, and polls across work, finance, tech, and study, though the lack of an axis and the uneven gap between bars make it slightly less crisp than a standard bar-chart glyph.

pass1.ambiguity: Without a baseline axis, the uneven gap between the second and third bar can make it look like an abstract layout icon, building skyline, or cellular signal bars at very small sizes.
